'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Mark Peterson DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mark Peterson]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Lukes Bionic Hand
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
